test_title: PYST 3 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

They had not closed the shop.

options.text: The shop has not been closed by them.
The shop was not closed by them..
The shop had not been closed by them.
The shop is not closed by them.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The shop had not been closed by them .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** past perfect tense** (had not closed).
 
• When converting a sentence from active to passive voice, the structure changes but the tense remains the same.
 
• In the past perfect tense, the passive voice structure is: **"had + not + been + past participle"**.
 
• Thus, the correct transformation of "They had not closed the shop" into passive voice is: **"The shop had not been closed by them."**

Correct sentence: *The shop had not been closed by them*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice Basics:**
 
 
• Used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action, rather than the subject performing it.
 
• Structure: **Object + auxiliary verb (form of "to be") + past participle + (optional: "by + subject").**
 
 
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• Active: She writes the report. → Passive: The report is written by her.
 
• Active: They were cleaning the room. → Passive: The room was being cleaned by them.
 
• Active: He had completed the task. → Passive: The task had been completed by him.
 
 

49:T
